background_image_description: Soft airbrushed radial gradient on a 1600x1600 canvas: warm off‑white base (#f5f2e6) with a large cobalt-to-sky blue cloud (#2f6fbd to #3b7fd6) dominating the right-center and fading smoothly to off‑white at the top-left and bottom-right; subtle vignette with gentle feathered edges and minimal grain.

nodes.svg_description: Three small, four-point sparkle stars rendered as diamond crosses with rounded points, solid fill #ffffff. One larger star (~34x34px) above-left of the text block; two smaller stars (~22x22px and ~16x16px) to the lower-right of the text block, spaced ~60px apart vertically.
